summary: Day 15 testing complete — Backend refactor (subscription + social routes extracted to modules), Battle CTA endpoint, Stripe webhook hardening, and APScheduler all working correctly. 53/53 backend tests pass. Frontend UI verified with Playwright.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend refactor successful: subscription routes moved to routes/subscription.py, social routes moved to routes/social.py
core.py enhanced with get_current_user (supports both Emergent OAuth sessions + JWT), is_admin, require_admin helpers
APScheduler running: logs show 'APScheduler started — DUB STREAK weekly award fires Mondays 00:05 UTC'
NEW /api/binders/public/{user_id}/battle-cta returns {is_champion, rank, thumbs_week, top_thumbs, crown_holder}
Top-3 weekly thumbs-up users correctly return is_champion=true, users outside top-3 return is_champion=false
Stripe webhook hardening: lenient mode (default) accepts valid JSON with invalid signature (verified=false), strict mode (STRIPE_WEBHOOK_STRICT=true) returns 400 on signature mismatch
Webhook bad JSON / empty body correctly returns 400 with error='bad_json'
Privacy enforced: /api/binders/public/{user_id} returns pulls WITHOUT case_pack_id, pack_type_id; source_pack='—'
All subscription endpoints functional: /checkout (returns cs_test_ URL), /status (tier+trial info), /cancel (requires active sub), /admin/info (admin-only), /webhook-mode (admin-only diagnostic)
Frontend BattleChampionBanner renders correctly for champion users with 'THIS WEEK'S CROWN HOLDER' label and 'Beat their X thumbs this week to take the crown' copy
DUB STREAK leaderboard on /binders page works with period toggle (week/all) and flame icon on #1
Login flow works: admin@flipnrip.com / AdminPass123! → redirects to /vault with JWT cookie
test_credentials: admin@flipnrip.com / AdminPass123! (role='admin' set in db.users, email in ADMIN_EMAILS env var)
seed_data_creation: Test users created with TEST_ prefix during testing, cleaned up after each test
context_for_next_testing_agent: Day 15 features fully tested: (1) Backend refactor complete — subscription routes in routes/subscription.py, social routes in routes/social.py, core.py has shared auth helpers. (2) APScheduler running for DUB STREAK weekly awards (Mondays 00:05 UTC). (3) NEW /api/binders/public/{user_id}/battle-cta returns champion info for top-3 weekly thumbs-up users. (4) Stripe webhook hardening: lenient mode (default) verifies signature but falls back to JSON parse on mismatch; strict mode (STRIPE_WEBHOOK_STRICT=true) returns 400 on mismatch. (5) Frontend BattleChampionBanner appears on champion binders with correct copy. (6) All 53 backend tests pass including Day 13, 14, and 15 test suites.
